_note: Verdicts on results/samples.md, in sample order (index 0 = item 1). Disagreements: which side is right for a definition row; headers: usable or partial for ranking (none unusable). Read against the pinned source by reviewers working from samples.md and the checkouts.

c/codecite_only.pattern: typedef struct/union/enum: the kernel keeps only the first typedef name and drops the tag and any later names

c/kernel_only.pattern: function-like #define macros (kind constant) and static tables codecite never emits; misses: an extern declaration and an anonymous nested union field

cpp/kernel_only.pattern: real C++ functions, methods, constructors and operators; codecite has no C++ grammar

java/codecite_only.pattern: methods of anonymous classes passed as arguments, which the kernel drops

java/kernel_only.pattern: static final and interface constant fields codecite leaves out by design; a boilerplate logger and a synthetic anonymous-class row

python/kernel_only.pattern: temporaries inside module-level for/if/try/__main__ blocks; one real try/except feature flag

ruby/kernel_only.pattern: real classes and methods; codecite has no Ruby grammar

rust/codecite_only.pattern: const or static items local to function bodies (optional) and documented trait associated consts the kernel misses

rust/kernel_only.pattern: kernel bug: a const named after its initialiser (`Register`, `PhantomData`, `None`) instead of its own name; plus impl associated types

javascript/codecite_only.pattern: single-letter functions in minified files (noise), `var $x = function x` bundle bindings the kernel names differently, object-literal hooks

javascript/kernel_only.pattern: `X.prototype.m = function`, API object methods and block-scoped module tables codecite misses; misses are block-local consts

tsx/codecite_only.pattern: codecite emits props-type member signatures, JSX onClick callbacks and test-local type aliases

tsx/kernel_only.pattern: kernel emits function-typed props-interface properties as methods and component locals; right on class arrow-function properties

typescript/codecite_only.pattern: codecite emits generated emscripten descriptor getters, config hooks and function-local type aliases

typescript/kernel_only.pattern: class arrow-function properties and arrow members of module-level objects codecite misses

c/header.pattern: signature field always empty (no parameters), return type only when on its own line; doc comments found, once a preprocessor comment

javascript/header.pattern: faithful; line comments above a definition captured only sometimes; much minified vendor code

python/header.pattern: parameters as written, docstrings; base classes left out

rust/header.pattern: typed signature, return type, /// docs; one doc block above an attribute missed

tsx/header.pattern: typed parameters incl. destructured props (sometimes very long); type aliases name only

typescript/header.pattern: typed parameters and return type; generic type parameters dropped; aliases and interfaces name only
